title: Improve token efficiency across agent recovery, coordination and tool use
outcome: Reduce known redundant context and coordination overhead while preserving governing constraints, acceptance evidence, required tests and independent reviews. Exact token measurements are optional and do not block the improvements.
acceptance: Required child outcomes address smaller recovery packets, relevant memory retrieval, unnecessary wakes, compact tool output, a lightweight assessment of known token overhead, and fresh session context for unrelated coding tasks.

Representative examples show what redundant content or coordination was removed and demonstrate that required instructions, actionable messages and verification evidence remain available. Exact token totals, a numeric savings threshold and new measurement infrastructure are not prerequisites.

completion.summary: Token-efficiency epic closed on existing child evidence (Greg via Advisor #1305): all 7 required children completed with independent evaluations; representative source-backed reductions recorded in holder map 432f87c9 (recovery 4400->3156 text / 4710->2901 JSON bytes, structured show 2018->1007, refusal 727->360, tool discovery 7162->1991) with required objective, criteria, STOP, locators, failures and refusal reasons retained. Independent evaluation 55ffcef234064fbbac6fe64d18d27589 passed 2/2. No new implementation or gate.
